name.en: US federal rule for ground vibration from surface coal mine blasting
name.es: Regla federal de EE. UU. para la vibración del terreno por voladuras en minas de carbón a cielo abierto

source.citation: 30 CFR § 816.67 (Office of Surface Mining Reclamation and Enforcement)
source.edition: Text as amended through 82 FR 54979 (17-Nov-2017); annual edition of 1-Jul-2023

quantity_basis: Note 1 of the table: particle velocity is recorded in three mutually perpendicular directions and the limit applies to each of the three.

criteria.reference: 30 CFR 816.67(d)(2)(i) table and (d)(3)(i); annual edition 1-Jul-2023, pp. 308-309

note.en: Interpretation: a row applies to d <= d_max (the rule reads '0 to 300' and '301 to 5,000' ft and says nothing for distances between 300 and 301 ft). W = (D/Ds)^2 is the charge in lb detonated in any 8 ms period, D in ft ((d)(3)(i)). A modified Ds needs site seismograph records and must keep the limit at a 95-percent confidence level ((d)(3)(ii)). The Figure 1 alternative (limits by frequency) is not included: its ~11 Hz breakpoint is not labelled and the source does not say how its segments join.
note.es: Interpretación: una fila rige para d <= d_max (la regla dice '0 to 300' y '301 to 5,000' ft y no dice nada de las distancias entre 300 y 301 ft). W = (D/Ds)^2 es la carga en lb detonada en cualquier periodo de 8 ms, con D en ft ((d)(3)(i)). Un Ds modificado necesita registros de sismógrafo del sitio y debe mantener el límite con un nivel de confianza del 95 % ((d)(3)(ii)). La alternativa de la Figura 1 (límites por frecuencia) no entra: su quiebre de ~11 Hz no está rotulado y la fuente no dice cómo se unen sus tramos.
